text: This project needs real filter-context manipulation, not just plain aggregation, because both the segment view and the territory view need a company-wide benchmark number.

Start with Total Sales, Order Count, and Average Order Value. Average Order Value wraps DIVIDE instead of a plain slash, so a segment or territory with zero orders returns a blank instead of an error.

The Marketing Manager's page needs each segment's share of company sales. ALL of DimCustomer strips away the segment filter on purpose, recalculating Total Sales as if every customer were included, exactly what that denominator needs.
The Sales Director's page needs the same idea applied to territory instead. ALL of DimTerritory removes the territory filter specifically, leaving any segment filter untouched.

You now have three measures that all start with Total Sales, and with no filters applied they all return the exact same number. Keep that in mind. Next lesson builds the Marketing Manager's segment page.
